text: Hello everyone, welcome back to my class.Today we are going to learn how to appropriately express opinions on a topic.In this period, you are expected to analyze the simple writing in terms of content, language, and editing.Write an opinion essay on the topic of having one more PE class every day for the school newspaper using appropriate language.Here's our task today.More and more people nowadays realize the importance of sports and pay more attention to it.So some students suggest having one more PE class every day.Do you agree with the suggestion?Today, our task is to write an opinion essay on the topic.Should students have one more PE class every day?But how to write an opinion essay?Let's firstly read a sample essay.Now, can you tell me what the author's opinion is?From the title, we can find out that the author believes the most important thing isn't winning a competition, it's taking part.Also, the writer tells us winning isn't the only way to be successful.Not everyone wants to be the winner.It would be wrong if we didn't praise the winner's achievement more than anyone else.However, there can only be one winner and the other people who take part in the competition are just as important to its success.So, if we should choose a conclusion from A to C to best summarize the writer's arguments, which one should be the best conclusion?For conclusion A, taking part and winning are not equally important, so A is not appropriate.For conclusion B, the author never argues that having fun in a competition is the only thing that matters, so B is not appropriate either.For conclusion C, although the writer explains in the fourth paragraph that it is necessary to praise winners, especially those who have put in years of hard work, the author still stresses that participation is more important than winning itself.So, conclusion C best summarizes the writer's argument.But how did the author develop this opinion essay in terms of content, language, and editing?Please try to complete the table on page 71 according to the information given in the sample essay.You will be given three minutes.Please try to complete the table on page paragraph, professional athletes go, in the fourth paragraph, we have the winner's achievements and everyone else.If the word ends with S, we add apostrophe directly, and if the word does not end with S, we add apostrophe S.Now, let's look at the content aspect of writing.Do you still remember how the writer introduces the topic in the opening paragraph?In the first paragraph, the author uses the structure like, some people think that, others believe that.The writer introduces the topic by presenting two different opinions about whether winning a competition is more important than taking part in one.In the body part, did you find the two arguments?The writer argues that taking part and doing one's best are more important than winning a competition.So, winning isn't the only way to be successful.She also argues that not everyone wants to win, because some ordinary people just want to take part.Did the writer use some examples to support her arguments?Yes, of course.We find some signal phrases here.The writer uses the example of rankings in races to explain why doing one's best is important.She also uses the example of a marathon race to show that people enter competitions for different reasons.As for the language part, at the beginning of the essay, what language structures does the writer use to introduce the topic?We've actually mentioned that part before.By presenting two different opinions about whether winning a competition is more important than taking part in one, the writer uses the structure of contrasting.The writer also raised a question.Which is more important, winning or taking part, to introduce the topic?As for the signal phrases used to introduce examples, we have for instance, for example, and such as.Actually, these are also the phrases that you can use when you would like to introduce examples.In the conclusion part, what phrases can be used to signal that you are writing a conclusion?From conclusion A to C, we may find to conclude, in summary, and to sum up.These are also the signal phrases you may use when conclude an essay.Okay, after reading carefully the sample essay and completing the table, let's have a brief review of the sample essay.At the very beginning, the author introduces the topic by using the structures of contrasting and raising a question.Then, in the second paragraph, the author uses the phrase, in my view, to put forward her arguments.Winning isn't the only way to be successful.In this part, the author uses, for instance, to offer an example to support her argument.After that, the author uses the phrase, in addition, to put forward another argument.In this part, the author also uses a signal phrase, for example, to further develop her new argument.And in the fourth paragraph, the author uses, on the other hand, to raise a counter-argument,and uses, however, in the end, to restate her own opinion.This kind of writing skill is to make her arguments more convincing and more logical.Also, in this part, the author applies an example of players in the Olympic games.In the conclusion part, the author uses, to sum up, to wrap the whole essay up.And states her opinion.Taking part and doing one's best are more important.So now, let's come back to our opinion essay task today.Firstly, you will have to decide your side.Do you think students should have one more PE class every day or not?After that, you need to think about your reasons or arguments as many as possible.Let's have a brainstorm together.Here, I have given you some ideas.Are they closely related to the topic today?Maybe we can delete some ideas that are not so related.Are they the most interesting ones?Maybe some more ideas are deleted.But you have the final say.And do you have sufficient ideas?If you do not have too much to say or do not have sufficient arguments and examples to support, you can delete more.Again, it's you that decide what should be left.Okay, so now, do you know how to write today's opinion essay?You can write your own opinion essay.Firstly, write down your name under the title.At the beginning, you can use contrasting structure to introduce the topic.In the body part, remember to use signal phrases like, in my view, in addition to raise your arguments.Sometimes, examples are good enough to support.If counter arguments are mentioned, it'll be better.And don't forget the conclusion.Now, please write your own version and the structure is for your reference.I will give you three minutes.Thank you.Okay ,times up.If you finished writing, you may use the checklist here to check your writing work and your peer compliance.
